paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search with HAYSTAC Phase II
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (converted from |g_gamma/g_KSVZ| using KSVZ line g_agamma^KSVZ ~ 1.98e-16 * m_a[ueV] GeV^-1, g_gamma^KSVZ=-0.97)
notes: HAYSTAC Phase II squeezed-state receiver axion haloscope. Reports 90% CL exclusion in units of |g_gamma/g_KSVZ|: 2.75x over 17.28-18.44 ueV (Phase IId) and 2.96x over 18.71-19.46 ueV (Phase IIc); combined 2.86x over 16.96-19.46 ueV. Values converted to g_agamma[GeV^-1] using the KSVZ coupling relation; conversion introduces some model-dependence. Mode-crossing gaps (17.89-18.08, 18.13-18.18 ueV) and RFI-vetoed regions excluded from coverage.
